lessons_learned.lesson: Never use absolute claim words like '100% Guaranteed Payout' or 'Never Denied'. Regulators in SG & MY mandate 'Subject to policy underwriting criteria and exclusions'.
lessons_learned.examples: Rejected: 'Guaranteed total loss protection'. Approved: 'Comprehensive high-value coverage with transparent claim guidelines.'

lessons_learned.lesson: DoctorShield content should address medical specialists with clinical empathy and precision, avoiding sensationalist medical malpractice fear-mongering.
lessons_learned.examples: Preferred: 'Protecting your career and reputation so you can focus on patient care.'

lessons_learned.lesson: Every post referencing premium rates or instant quotes must include the standard insurance intermediary disclaimer.
lessons_learned.examples: Disclaimer: 'JA Assure is an authorized insurance broker. Terms, conditions, and underwriting limits apply.'
